headline: Galp Shares Drop 10% Following Third-Quarter Guidance Release
summary: Shares of Portuguese energy company Galp fell 10% following the publication of its third-quarter 2026 financial guidance.
why: Galp Energia is an integrated oil and gas operator listed on the Euronext Lisbon exchange.

impacts.name: Galp Energia
impacts.why: Quarterly operational guidance below market expectations often leads to equity repricing.

why_moved: Corporate guidance updates reflecting lower expectations trigger immediate equity selling among institutional holders.
